QUICK READ / CEILINGS & SERVICES

How to install gypsum false ceilings in your offices step by step guide.

Treat the ceiling as part of the whole room.

Three ideas to take into your workplace conversation.

01 / 03

Start with the services above it

A ceiling has to work around lighting, ventilation, fire services and access requirements. Establish the existing constraints and coordinate specialist advice before choosing a finished pattern.

Next idea ↓
02 / 03

Compare systems by use

A suspended grid may offer practical access; a continuous finish can create a quieter visual field. Review repairability, acoustic performance and the effect on available height, using product-specific information.

Next idea ↓
03 / 03

Coordinate the room below

Align the ceiling and lighting with the furniture arrangement, not just the outline of the room. Recheck the setting when partitions, meeting tables or workstations move.

Put it in your brief ↗
A PRACTICAL TAKEAWAY

Before you decide.

  • Survey existing height and service locations.
  • Ask how maintenance access will be provided.
  • Review a sample and a reflected ceiling plan together.
